say:3:1320342001:1.text: It's okay, Evgeny. This is our friend, Ludovic. He won't hurt you!
say:3:1320342001:1.source_cn: 大叔，别紧张。这位亡——唔，这位活死人，是我们的朋友，...

say:6:1320342002:1.text: That's right! Ludovic's the one who bought your son's painting and fixed it!
say:6:1320342002:1.source_cn: 没错，他是个好人！不仅买下了列夫斯基最后那幅画，还帮忙...

say:7:1320342003:1.text: So you're the kind-hearted artist... I never imagined you'd be an undead...
say:7:1320342003:1.source_cn: 原来您就是那位好心的艺术家……真没想到，您竟然会是一位...

say:8:1320342004:1.text: I apologize if I startled you.

say:9:1320342005:1.text: I wouldn't have revealed myself had that man not uttered such insufferable remarks.
say:9:1320342005:1.source_cn: 如果不是那个商人说了那么令人讨厌的话，我不会现身的。

say:12:1320342007:1.text: Sir... I have a favor to ask you...
say:12:1320342007:1.source_cn: 活死人先生……我、我有件事想求您帮忙……

say:13:1320342008:1.text: Could you... finish the painting that Levski left behind?
say:13:1320342008:1.source_cn: 您能不能……把列夫斯基留下的这幅画补完？

say:15:1320342010:1.text: I think a complete painting would sell for more than an unfinished one...
say:15:1320342010:1.source_cn: 我、我是觉得，一幅完整的画应该比半成品能卖更多的钱……

say:16:1320342011:1.text: Huh?! W-why would you want to sell it?!

say:19:1320342012:1.text: I don't understand either... This painting was Levski's pride and joy, and he really wanted you to have it.
say:19:1320342012:1.source_cn: 大叔，这幅画可是列夫斯基最得意的作品，他唯一的愿望就是...

say:20:1320342013:1.text: I... I know. I've let him down... but I'm out of options.
say:20:1320342013:1.source_cn: 我、我知道。是我对不起列夫斯基……可是我没办法。

say:21:1320342014:1.text: My family's buried in debt, and we're struggling to put food on the table. I can manage hunger, but I can't let my wife and daughter starve...
say:21:1320342014:1.source_cn: 因为列夫斯基的病，我们家负债累累，现在连吃饭的钱都凑不...

say:22:1320342015:1.text: As much as I'd love to keep the painting, all I can do is look at it and be reminded of my son who will never come back...
say:22:1320342015:1.source_cn: 我也很想留下这幅画……可留下它又有什么用呢？我们一家只...

say:23:1320342016:1.text: But if I sell it, my family can at least get by. We can find a way to pay off our debts and keep living...
say:23:1320342016:1.source_cn: 但要是卖掉它，我们一家至少能维持生计，总有法子还上债，...

say:28:1320342019:1.text: Hmm... Chippy can tell this must be a really tough choice for you!
say:28:1320342019:1.source_cn: 好吧……大叔做出这个选择一定很艰难，满满能理解！

say:31:1320342020:1.text: So, Ludovic, would you be willing to help him out?
say:31:1320342020:1.source_cn: 那……柳博米尔，你愿意帮大叔这个忙吗？

say:32:1320342021:1.text: The painting's almost done; it shouldn't take much longer to finish...
say:32:1320342021:1.source_cn: 这幅画已经完成得差不多了，补全工作应该不会花费太多时间……

say:35:1320342023:1.text: ...Wait, don't just walk away without a word!
say:35:1320342023:1.source_cn: ……等等，柳博米尔？你不要一声不吭地走掉呀！

say:37:1320342018:0.text: If I had another way, I wouldn't want to sell Levski's last piece...
